author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

In CMSSW_20_1_0_pre1 displaying a Phase 2 tag with an empty EE pulse, like e.g. `EcalSimPulseShapes_TB2025_v1`, crashes due to a bug that sets the number of EE bins of the TProfile equal to the number of EB bins.
This PR fixes this and displays no EE profiles if there is no EE pulse in the tag.
In addition it adds some more information on the pulses to the plots.

#### PR validation:

`getPayloadData.py --plugin pluginEcalSimPulseShape_PayloadInspector --plot plot_EcalSimPulseShapeProfile --tag EcalSimPulseShapes_TB2025_v1 --time_type Run --iovs '{"start_iov": "1", "end_iov": "1"}' --db Prod --test` does not crash anymore and generates the proper pulse plots.
title: Update EcalSimPulseShape payload inspector for empty EE pulses
